crossRefs.note: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”
He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”

translations.web: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.
translations.bsb: When they were back inside the house, the disciples asked Jesus about this matter.
translations.kjv: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same
translations.asv: And in the house the disciples asked him again of this matter.
